# 4 Ezra Chapter 4 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** Core apocalypse — First dialogue

---

**1** Then the angel who had been dispatched to me — his name was Uriel — spoke up

**2** and said: Your understanding has completely broken down even in this world, so what makes you think you can grasp the ways of the Most High?

**3** I said: You're right, my lord. He replied: I have been sent to show you three things, three riddles to put to you.

**4** If you can answer even one of them, I will reveal the path you're desperate to understand, and explain where this evil heart of ours actually comes from.

**5** I said: Go ahead. He said: Weigh fire for me. Or measure a measure of wind. Or bring back a day that has already gone.

**6** I answered: Who born of a woman could possibly do those things? Why are you asking me this?

**7** He said: If I had asked you — How many rooms are at the bottom of the ocean? How many springs feed the deep? How many roads lead up past the sky? What are the doorways of the underworld? What are the paths through paradise?

**8** — you might well have said: I've never been to the bottom of the ocean, I've never visited the underworld, I've never climbed to heaven.

**9** But I asked you about fire and wind and time — things you live with every single day, things you cannot exist without — and you have nothing to say.

**10** He said: You can't even understand the things that belong to you personally —

**11** so how is your mind supposed to grasp the way of the Most High? Or how is something already rotting with corruption supposed to understand what incorruption even looks like?

**12** I said to him: Honestly? It would have been better if we'd never been born at all, rather than arriving in this world, living wickedly, suffering for it, and being fully aware of why we're suffering.

**13** He answered me with a story: Once, the forest trees decided to go to war against the sea — they wanted to drive it back. And the sea decided to fight the forest — it wanted to swallow it whole.

**14** But the trees' plan came to nothing, because fire came and burned them down.

**15** And the sea's plan also came to nothing, because the sand held firm and turned the waves back.

**16** If you were the judge in this case, which side would you rule for? Which would you condemn?

**17** I answered: Both plans were pointless. The land belongs to the forest; the sea belongs to its waves — that's the natural order.

**18** He said: Well judged. So why haven't you applied that same logic to your own situation?

**19** Just as the land was made for the forest and the sea was made for its waves, people who live on earth can only grasp earthly things, and those who live above the heights can only understand what is beyond the heights.

**20** I answered: Then why, my lord, was I given this capacity to understand at all?

**21** I was not trying to investigate the ways of the Most High or plumb the cosmic depths. I only wanted to understand what happens to us every single day:

**22** Why has Israel been humiliated before the nations? Why has the people you loved been handed over to godless foreigners? Why has our ancestral law been thrown out? Why have the written covenants simply vanished?

**23** We have passed through the world like a swarm of locusts. Our lives are like morning mist. And we are not even worth showing mercy to.

**24** But what about God's own name — the name invoked over us? That is what I am really asking about.

**25** He answered: If you live long enough, you will be astonished — because this age is racing toward its end.

**26** It cannot hold the promises made to the righteous for much longer. This age is saturated with grief and disease.

**27** The evil that was planted in it has not yet produced its full harvest, and the field seeded with wickedness is not yet ripe.

**28** The seed of evil was sown in Adam's heart at the very beginning — think of the crop of wickedness that has grown since then, and think how much more is still coming before the threshing day arrives!

**29** Reckon up for yourself the harvest of wickedness already ripened —

**30** and understand that the good harvest cannot be cut until after this age runs its course.

**31** I said: How long? When exactly? Our years are so few, and they are bitter.

**32** He answered: Don't try to move faster than the Most High. You are only thinking about yourself, but the Most High is thinking about multitudes.

**33** Don't you know that the souls of the righteous are right now asking in their resting places: How long do we wait here? When does our reward finally come?

**34** And to them the archangel Jeremiel has answered: Only when your number is complete — when as many have come as must come. For God has weighed this age in a balance,

**35** measured the times by measure, counted the seasons by number, and will not shift or start them until the appointed total is reached.

**36** I answered: O LORD above us — we who live on earth already know this much; how much more do you know.

**37** Like a woman nine months pregnant whose labor pains begin as delivery approaches — these things will not be delayed even a moment beyond their fixed time.

**38** Then I said: If I have found any favor with you, if it is at all possible, if I am worthy —

**39** tell me this one more thing: Is there more time still to come than has already passed? Or has the greater part already gone by?

**40** I have heard about what is past; I have no knowledge of what is coming.

**41** He said: Stand to my right, and I will explain what a parable means.

**42** I stood and watched. A blazing furnace passed before me, and after the flame died away, I looked — the smoke was still there.

**43** Then a storm cloud full of rain passed before me, and after the downpour was over, drops still clung to the cloud.

**44** He said: Think about it — more rain fell than drops remained, and more fire burned than smoke was left. In the same way, more time has passed than remains, but drops and smoke are still there.

**45** I prayed and said: Am I actually going to live to see those days? Who will even be alive then?

**46** He answered: About the signs you are asking about, I can tell you something. But about how long you personally will live — that is not what I was sent to reveal, and I do not know.
